name: Georgia FBLA (Future Business Leaders of America)
what_you_do: Join a school business club. It has learning programs and contests. It has state projects. It offers scholarships and awards. It also has state and national conferences.
who_can_apply: Georgia students interested in business careers. The home page does not list grade, age or dues.
pay_detail: Not a job. Dues are not listed on the page read.
deadline_text: No join deadline listed on the page.
how_to_apply: The page says 'Joining is simple!' and links a chapter finder to see which FBLA chapters are close to you. Students join through a local chapter.
notes: Ask your school whether it has an FBLA chapter. The page read does not list the state conference dates or dues.
